# Plan A coverage matrix (generated by `closure coverage --write`; do not edit by hand)

Sources: the AI 2040 Verification Plan and its Get Involved page, as pasted. Status vocabulary: implemented (code and tests here), hardware-gated (code here, needs a cluster), external (another repo on the account), partial, not-started, physical and policy (outside software scope).

**79 requirements.** Software-addressable: 60, of which 60 have code or a repository behind them. implemented 27, hardware-gated 22, external 0, partial 11, not-started 0, physical 12, policy 7.

Total completion of Plan A is not achievable in software: physical, diplomatic and manufacturing items are marked as such and are not counted as covered.

Paths that start with `external/` are in the repositories vendored under external/ (pinned by external/MANIFEST.json); `closure external test` runs their own test suites.
